say:2:1220309001:0.text: Excuse me, are you Mr. Ricard? We have a few questions we'd like to ask you.
say:2:1220309001:0.source_cn: 请问你是拉夫特先生吗？我们有几个问题想找你打听。

say:4:1220309003:0.text: How rude...! Even if you haven't seen a mage's familiar before, you've at least heard of them, right?
say:4:1220309003:0.source_cn: 真失礼……就算没有亲眼见过魔法师的使魔，起码也听说过吧。

say:5:1220309004:0.text: Familiar... Do mages like having rodents as familiars? That thing I saw before... Was it a familiar?
say:5:1220309004:0.source_cn: 使魔……魔法师都喜欢用大老鼠当使魔吗？我看见的那东西，...

say:6:1220309005:0.text: I really need to educate the people of Rustport about magic.
say:6:1220309005:0.source_cn: 唉……我有必要给锈锚港的人普及一些魔法常识了。

say:7:1220309006:0.text: Never mind that for now... Can you tell us where you saw the giant rat you've been mentioning to people?
say:7:1220309006:0.source_cn: 算了，先不说这些。你能不能告诉我们，在哪看见了大老鼠？

say:9:1220309008:0.text: It was very dark when I saw them. A large group of "something" ran past. I was so scared that I tripped over my own feet.
say:9:1220309008:0.source_cn: 当时天很黑，那群东西贴着墙根跑过去，吓得我踩了自己的脚！
say:9:1220309008:0.male: It was very dark when I saw them. A large group of "something" ran past. I was so scared that I tripped over my own feet.
say:9:1220309008:0.female: It was very dark when I saw them. A large group of "something" ran past. I was so scared that I tripped over my own feet.

say:11:1220309009:0.text: Chippy will take a closer look.
say:11:1220309009:0.male: Chippy will take a closer look.
